707057a983d0.title: Complete an SDC questionnaire
707057a983d0.content: Skill complete-sdc-questionnaire: A health worker (or a client, on their own device) completes a FHIR R4 Questionnaire conforming to Structured Data Capture as their device renders it, and the result is a QuestionnaireResponse. Generic for any DAK form: a registration, a visit, a referral. Input is the Questionnaire as rendered, with any pre-populated answers; output is the completed QuestionnaireResponse. Named by: Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and VHL Issuance, Wallet Consent . Skill id: complete-sdc-questionnaire · Package: authoring-who-smart-guidelines · Task Task_Complete of questionnaire-data-capture.bpmn (Process_QuestionnaireDataCapture), lane health-worker. Performed by a person: the health worker, or a client filling in a form on their own device. Their device’s form filler does the rendering; this skill is what the person does with it and what the result must be. The meaning of every element is the FHIR R4 Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse and HL7 Structured Data Capture (SDC): this skill restates none of it. A DAK’s forms are SDC Questionnaires (for example sdc-questionnaire-extr-smap in WHO’s immunization and HIV DAKs); a form that is not cannot be completed by this skill.

f6ae70ddce76.title: Input and output
f6ae70ddce76.content: The contract is input.schema.json and output.schema.json. | In: the questionnaire (a FHIR R4 Questionnaire resource), how it is renderedOn (form factor, language, whether offline), and, when the form is about someone, the subject and the SDC launchContext values; any prepopulated QuestionnaireResponse that SDC $populate or the device filled in before the person saw the form. | Out: the questionnaireResponse, and the issues the form filler raised that the person chose to leave (only for a response saved in-progress). | .

033522a23b49.title: Preconditions
033522a23b49.content: . | The Questionnaire is active (or draft, in a test), and the device renders it whole: no item is silently dropped. | When the form has a subject, the person has identified the client. | .

98495900a8e0.title: What the person does
98495900a8e0.content: . | Read what is shown. Pre-populated answers are proposals: confirm or correct each one; the form filler marks none as confirmed for them. | Answer the enabled items. An item whose enableWhen (or SDC enableWhenExpression) is false is not shown and gets no answer. | Satisfy the form’s checks before submitting: every enabled required item is answered; each answer has the item’s type and stays within its answerOption/answerValueSet, maxLength, and SDC minValue, maxValue and regex constraints. | Submit, which marks the response completed. Leaving it unfinished saves it in-progress, and nothing downstream reads it as complete. | .

39823c0dabab.title: Success criteria
39823c0dabab.content: . | questionnaireResponse.questionnaire is the Questionnaire’s canonical (url|version); subject is the client the form is about. | status is completed, every enabled required item has an answer, no disabled item has one, and every linkId is one of the Questionnaire’s. | The response validates against the Questionnaire (SDC form behaviour). | .

943ad58e30ce.title: What it does not do
943ad58e30ce.content: Creating the client’s resources from the answers is the system’s step, extract-questionnaire-response. Authoring or reviewing the form itself is fhir-harness’s fhir-questionnaire-wireframe.

9f11777b23b0.title: Consent to share a health link
9f11777b23b0.content: Skill holder-consent-to-share: The holder decides what a health link (a Verifiable Health Link or a SMART Health Link) shares: which members’ records, protected by which passcode, until when. That choice is the holder’s consent, and the sharer issues nothing beyond it. Input is the records the sharer offers; output is the share request. Performed by a person. Named by: Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and VHL Issuance, Wallet Consent . Performed by a person: the holder (IHE ITI VHL VHL Holder). Role vhl-holder. The sharer that acts on the answer is vhl-share for a VHL; for a SMART Health Link it is the SHL sharer, which sets the link’s P flag and exp from the same answer. Which kind of link is the sharer’s, not the holder’s, choice.

e242cc984fab.title: Input and output
e242cc984fab.content: The contract is input.schema.json and output.schema.json. | In: the offer: the members whose records the sharer holds and may share, with the documents each has (an IPS, vaccination certificates), and the longest maxExpiry the sharer allows. | Out: the share request: the members (and documents) chosen, the passcode the holder sets, and the expiry. | .

9740dd66e303.title: What the holder does
9740dd66e303.content: . | Choose who is shared: one member, several, or none. Nothing is chosen by default. | Set a passcode the holder can say aloud, and an expiry no later than the trip or visit needs. | Confirm. Declining at any step shares nothing. | .

567193cf04e8.title: Success criteria
567193cf04e8.content: . | The share request names only what the holder chose; the sharer issues nothing else (vhl-share encrypts exactly those documents). | The passcode is handed to the sharer once, to protect the manifest, and is not printed on the QR. | With nothing chosen, no link is issued. | .

0296e6a7534a.title: Present a health credential
0296e6a7534a.content: Skill holder-present-credential: The holder shows the one health credential a receiver asks for, as a QR: an HCERT (HC1:) on paper or in a wallet app, or a health link: the HCERT carrying a Verifiable Health Link, or a SMART Health Link (shlink:/). Input is what the holder holds and what is asked for; output is the QR shown. Performed by a person; the library has no holder-side operation. Named by: Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent . Performed by a person: the holder (IHE ITI VHL VHL Holder, smart-trust Holder), often a parent presenting a child’s records. Role vhl-holder.

485aec56701e.title: Input and output
485aec56701e.content: The contract is input.schema.json and output.schema.json. | In: the credentials held, each with the member it is about, its kind (hcert, vhl or shl), its medium (paper or wallet) and its qr text (HC1:… for an HCERT or VHL, shlink:/… for a SMART Health Link); and the request: which member, and which kind. | Out: the credential shown, and when it is a health link whose manifest needs a passcode (VHL, or an SHL with the P flag), that the holder must now say it (passcodeToSay). | .

c89d0309f4d6.title: Preconditions
c89d0309f4d6.content: The credential was issued to the holder (an HCERT by the issuing system, hcert-prefix-context; a VHL by the sharer, vhl-share; an SHL by its sharer, per the SMART Health Link specification).

5bae8cc3ab58.title: What the holder does
5bae8cc3ab58.content: . | Pick the credential asked for, and only it: one member, one QR. | Show the QR whole and steady (paper flat, screen bright); the receiver scans it (receiver-scan-credential). | For a passcode-protected health link, say the passcode to the health worker; it is never printed beside the QR. | .

f83635595103.title: Success criteria
f83635595103.content: . | The receiver reads exactly the qr of the credential asked for. | Nothing about any other member is shown. | .

4df8e6f63ac3.title: Inform the client
4df8e6f63ac3.content: Skill inform-client: A health worker tells the client (or caregiver) what was decided and what happens next, in words and, where the DAK gives one, on a slip or card: a referral, a return date, a result. Input is what to tell and the client’s language; output is that the client was told, and what they were handed. Generic for any DAK step that ends with the client being informed. Named by: Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and VHL Issuance, Wallet Consent . Skill id: inform-client · Package: authoring-who-smart-guidelines · Performed by a person in a health-worker lane. WHO’s immunization DAK has it as IMMZ.D7 “Counsel client” and IMMZ.D9 “Inform client when to return”.

5372b23c60cf.title: What the health worker does

9897faaf2c95.title: Success criteria

b0c09b1d6216.title: Scan a health credential
b0c09b1d6216.content: Skill receiver-scan-credential: The health worker at a receiving system scans the QR a holder shows (an HCERT, a VHL carried in an HCERT, or a SMART Health Link) and, for a passcode-protected health link, enters the passcode the holder says. Input is the QR as shown; output is its text (and passcode) handed to the receiving system, which verifies it or follows the link. Performed by a person; never judges authenticity. Named by: Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent . Performed by a person: the health worker operating a receiving system (a CHW app, a clinic EHR, a point-of-care viewer). Role receiving-health-worker. What happens to the scan is the system’s: hcert-verify (or its unverified triage read) and vhl-receive; for a SMART Health Link, the SHL receiver’s manifest request.

b653e73738ce.title: Input and output
b653e73738ce.content: The contract is input.schema.json and output.schema.json. | In: the shown QR, its medium (paper or a screen), and, for a VHL, the passcode the holder says. | Out: the qr text read, one per QR, and the passcode when one was entered. | .

2b056bb22e72.title: What the health worker does
2b056bb22e72.content: . | Scan each QR once, with the receiving system’s camera. | For a passcode-protected health link, type the passcode the holder says; never ask to see it written. | Hand over to the system, which verifies. The health worker does not decide whether a credential is genuine: the system’s result says so. | .

1dfe0d2b90c6.title: Success criteria
1dfe0d2b90c6.content: . | Each QR’s text reaches the receiving system unchanged (HC1:… or shlink:/…). | A QR that will not scan is reported as such, and the records are treated like paper. | .

b1e490c25759.title: A SMART Health Link is the same receipt, with another carrier
b1e490c25759.content: A plain SMART Health Link (shlink:/, from receiver-scan-credential) is followed by the same steps: the manifest request with the passcode when its P flag is set, the manifest, and each document decrypted. It carries no HCERT, so there is no signature to verify (hcert-verify is skipped) and the receiver cannot tell who issued the link. A “Verifiable SHL” (smart-ips-pilgrimage’s term) is a VHL, verified as above.
